FLEET TELEMATICS SERVICES AGREEMENT — with
ADDENDUM No. 1

PART I — PRINCIPAL AGREEMENT (signed 2 September 2025)

Parties: Kestrelnet Telematics Private Limited, Plot 18, Phase II, IDA Uppal, Hyderabad 500039 ("Kestrelnet"), and Velora Consumer Private Limited, Bengaluru ("Customer").

P1. Duration. The services run from 15 September 2025 to 14 September 2027 (the "First Period"). The Agreement then continues automatically for further periods of one (1) year each unless a party gives notice to stop not later than thirty (30) days before the First Period or any further period ends.

P2. Charges. ₹420 per vehicle per month for 180 vehicles (approximately ₹9,07,200 per year), plus GST. Charges stay the same for the First Period; for each further period they may be increased by Kestrelnet by the annual rise in the CPI (Combined), with no upper limit stated.

P3. Payment. Within thirty (30) days of invoice.

P4. Service credits. Where GPS data latency exceeds 5 minutes for more than 2% of pings in a month, Kestrelnet shall credit 5% of that month's charges.

P5. Early termination. The Customer may end the Agreement on sixty (60) days' notice for any reason.

P6. Notices. By email to the addresses in the order form.

P7. Law. Laws of India; courts at Hyderabad.

Signed: Kestrelnet — [signature] R. Venkatesh, Director — 02.09.2025 · Customer — [signature] Kavita Deshpande, CFO — 02.09.2025

PART II — ADDENDUM No. 1 (signed 20 March 2026)

A1. With effect from the date of this Addendum, in clause P1 the words "thirty (30) days" are replaced by "ninety (90) days".

A2. In clause P3, "thirty (30) days" is replaced by "sixty (60) days".

A3. Everything else in the Principal Agreement stays as it is. Where this Addendum and the Principal Agreement differ, this Addendum governs.

Signed: Kestrelnet — [signature] R. Venkatesh, Director — 18.03.2026 · Customer — [signature] Kavita Deshpande, CFO — 20.03.2026

[company seal: circular stamp reading "KESTRELNET TELEMATICS PRIVATE LIMITED" with "BENGALURU" in the centre]
